hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "vespasian plan|vespasian apply|validate-site" && echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "pass|success|compiled|complete|applied"; then echo "[post-build-qa] Plan/apply step succeeded. Run the full quality gate: vespasian apply <plan> --dry-run, then vespasian qa (screenshots the live Wix site vs the source design and emits a FidelityReport)."; fi'
hooks.description: Suggest the dry-run + visual QA gate after a BuildPlan compiles or applies successfully

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "git commit"; then find .vespasian -type f -name global.css 2>/dev/null | while read -r css; do HITS=$(grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b" "$css" 2>/dev/null | grep -v -- --vsp- | head -3); if [ -n "$HITS" ]; then echo "[pre-commit-guard] Hex literals outside --vsp-* token definitions in $css — route colors through the ThemePlan palette / --vsp-* variables:"; echo "$HITS"; fi; done; fi'
hooks.description: Design-token guard: flag literal hex in translate output (global.css) that bypasses --vsp-* tokens before commits

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "node --test" && echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "coverage"; then echo "[coverage-check] Review the node --test coverage table above. Keep packages/pipeline and packages/wix-driver line coverage at or above 80% (node --test --experimental-test-coverage)."; fi'
hooks.description: Remind to check coverage threshold after node --test runs with coverage output

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "visual-diff.js" && echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -q "PASS"; then echo "[dark-mode-reminder] Visual diff passed. Consider running dark mode verification against the published site: ./scripts/check-dark-mode.sh <url>"; fi'
hooks.description: Remind to run dark mode verification after visual diff passes

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "vespasian (plan|apply)"; then MAX_PLAN_KB=2048; find .vespasian/plans -type f -name "*.json" 2>/dev/null | while read -r plan; do SIZE_KB=$(du -sk "$plan" | cut -f1); if [ "${SIZE_KB:-0}" -gt "$MAX_PLAN_KB" ]; then echo "[bundle-guard] BuildPlan $plan is ${SIZE_KB}KB — exceeds ${MAX_PLAN_KB}KB sanity limit. Plans must reference staged media by id/slug, never embed asset bytes."; fi; done; fi'
hooks.description: BuildPlan size sanity check (>2MB) after plan compile/apply — embedded asset bytes are a plan smell

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "node --test|pnpm .*test" && echo "$TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "fail 0|all tests passed|tests? passed"; then echo "[mutation-test] All tests passed. Optionally validate test quality with StrykerJS mutation testing: npx stryker run (not installed by default; see vespasian-testing-workflows skill)."; fi'
hooks.description: Suggest StrykerJS mutation testing after all node tests pass
